name: Buck
oneLiner: BUCK was Bridge Building's USDC-redeemable savings stablecoin backed by Strategy Inc. preferred stock (STRC) before its April 2026 wind-down.

obituary.epitaph: The savings coin closed the vault
obituary.obituary: By April 2026, Buck's public site had become a shutdown notice saying the project was closed and funds were returned to token holders, while the former transparency page no longer served a reserve disclosure. Pharos freezes BUCK as a discontinued archive rather than an active yield-bearing stablecoin: the last live cache showed only about $4.6K of residual supply, no reliable price, and no working issuer reserve feed. The failure mode was an orderly wind-down rather than an oracle or collateral break, but live monitoring no longer has an active issuer disclosure surface to follow.

collateral: USDC liquidity reserve for redemptions plus Strategy Inc. perpetual preferred stock (STRC), a BTC-backed equity instrument; treasury reported at 1.79× reserve ratio (Mar 2026 attestation by The Network Firm)
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redemption against USDC via the LiquidityWindow smart contract; AML-verified primary market participants only; yield distributed monthly as additional BUCK tokens (rebase)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

yieldConfig.yieldSource: Strategy Inc. STRC dividends (BTC-backed preferred equity)

mintAuthority.summary: BUCK was issued by Buck Labs as an RWA-backed savings coin; access-gated stewards minted and refunded BUCK through the issuer-controlled LiquidityWindow contract, pricing against an off-chain STRC collateral attestation with USDC settling into the LiquidityReserve. No permissionless or user-collateralized mint route existed.

controls.label: Buck Labs LiquidityWindow mint/refund desk
controls.evidence: Per the buck-v1 contract docs, access-gated stewards mint/refund BUCK through the LiquidityWindow against a collateral-aware peg with per-account caps and oracle freshness; primary-market access is AML-gated and operator-controlled.

controls.label: PolicyManager / CollateralAttestation (off-chain STRC valuation)
controls.evidence: CollateralAttestation is the on-chain copy of off-chain STRC valuation; PolicyManager gates fees, spreads and mint/refund allowances via Green/Yellow/Red/Emergency bands, so issuer-controlled off-chain attestation governs whether mints are permitted.

review.evidence: Buck Labs documentation and the buck-v1 contract architecture describe a centralized, AML-gated primary market: only access-gated stewards mint/refund via the LiquidityWindow against issuer-attested STRC collateral. No public on-chain admin/Safe state was independently confirmed.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Mechanism established from issuer docs/contract READMEs; the live on-chain owner/minter admin was not independently resolved and the project has wound down.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain owner/minter-admin and any proxy admin of the LiquidityWindow before raising confidence.
